2026-10-05.content:
External IPv6 addresses are now supported for
[Standard Tier](https://docs.cloud.google.com/network-tiers/docs/overview#standard_tier) in **Preview**.
For more information, see [IPv6 subnet ranges](https://docs.cloud.google.com/vpc/docs/subnets#ipv6-ranges).

summary.title: Preview: External IPv6 support for Standard Tier
summary.summary: External IPv6 addresses are now supported for Standard Tier in Preview. This feature allows for enhanced connectivity options. For more details, refer to the documentation on IPv6 subnet ranges.
